pr_title: Configuration variables for GitHub Actions impl 1/2
pr_body:
This PR adds common functionality for CLI for configuration variables.  These shared functions are used in two or more operations with variables through cli.

The implementation of the actions which can be undertaken being tracked in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/6902

Fixes https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/6836

issue_context.title: Add support for setting configuration variables (actions)
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

Starting from today, GitHub supports configuration variables: https://github.blog/changelog/2023-01-10-github-actions-support-for-configuration-variables-in-workflows/
It's something that is currently missing in GitHub cli.

### Proposed solution

It would be nice to have an option to set configuration variables in a similar way as `gh secret`. I'm pretty sure many users will appreciate that.

### Additional context

None.
comments:
Good idea.

The UX for this should map to `gh secret`.

See: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/variables?apiVersion=2022-11-28

An important consideration is a friendly and clear error message if the API endpoint doesn't exist, which will be true of recent GitHub Enterprise versions.
